# Components

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill.mjs from registry/catalog.mjs. Don't edit by hand. -->

All 64 components, grouped by the job they do. The item is the React name: add `-web`, `-vue`, `-svelte` or `-solid` for another layer (`npx shadcn@latest add @kind-ui/tool-vue`). Each component's page is `https://kindui.dev/llms.mdx/docs/agent-ui/components/<item>.md`.

## Chat core

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `suggestion` | Suggestion | You offer prompts a person can send in one press, like starters or follow-ups. |
| `feedback` | Feedback | A person rates a reply with thumbs up or down and can add a comment. |
| `sources` | Sources | A reply used sources and you show them as a count that opens a list of links. |
| `inline-citation` | Inline Citation | A sentence cites sources and you mark the spot with a card that shows them. |
| `conversation` | Conversation | You show a scrolling list of messages that follows new content as it streams. |
| `message` | Message | You render one turn, with its role, status, author, time and copy, regenerate, edit or retry. |
| `markdown` | Markdown | You render model text, streamed or finished; it repairs half-written blocks as they arrive. |
| `code-block` | Code Block | You show code outside Markdown, or need its copy, wrap or a highlight function. |
| `markdown-table` | Markdown Table | You show a table outside Markdown that has to scroll sideways and copy. |
| `composer` | Composer | A person writes the prompt: send and stop, mentions, commands, attachments and saved drafts. |
| `attachments` | Attachments | You list attached files on their own, outside the Composer, which already shows them. |
| `uploader` | Uploader | Files upload with progress, and a person can cancel or retry each one. |

## Composer controls

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model-selector` | Model Selector | A person picks the model from a searchable list grouped by provider. |
| `reasoning-effort` | Reasoning Effort | A person picks how hard the model thinks, from a few levels. |
| `context-meter` | Context Meter | You show how full the context window is, with token counts and cost. |
| `picker` | Picker | A person chooses from a long, searchable list that doesn't fit a menu. |
| `add-menu` | Add Menu | A plus button adds files, folders, tools or anything else to the prompt. |
| `settings-menu` | Settings Menu | A few on and off toggles and choices sit behind one composer button. |
| `approval-mode` | Approval Mode | A person chooses how much the agent may do without asking. |
| `model-control` | Model Control | One composer button sets the model, its effort and other settings together. |
| `context-bar` | Context Bar | You show what's attached to the prompt as removable chips. |
| `dictation` | Dictation | A person speaks the prompt through a speech source you provide. |

## Agent steps and decisions

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `step` | Step | You show work of your own that isn't a tool call, as a collapsible step with a status. |
| `reasoning` | Reasoning | The model streams its thinking; it collapses to "Thought for N s" when done. |
| `tool` | Tool | The model calls a tool: its input, output, error and, when asked, approval. |
| `chain-of-thought` | Chain of Thought | Many steps fold under one summary that opens into each step. |
| `task` | Task | An agent works through a list of steps and you count how many are done. |
| `plan` | Plan | The agent proposes steps a person can Accept, with a progress bar. |
| `subagent` | Subagent | A subagent runs its own steps, can be stopped, and returns a result. |
| `queue` | Queue | Prompts wait their turn, and a person can reorder or clear them. |
| `confirmation` | Confirmation | An action that isn't a tool call needs a person to approve or deny it. |
| `question` | Question | The agent asks a person to choose an option or write an answer before it goes on. |
| `checkpoint` | Checkpoint | A person can restore the conversation to an earlier point, after a dialog asks first. |
| `job-progress` | Job Progress | A long job runs with a percent or stage, its time left, Cancel or Retry, and a log. |

## Developer output

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `document` | Document | The agent hands back a document with copy, download and a preview. |
| `generated-image` | Generated Image | The agent makes an image, from progress to a full-size view. |
| `file-tree` | File Tree | You show the files a change touched, with lines added and removed. |
| `terminal` | Terminal | You show a command's output in ANSI colors as it streams, with its exit code. |
| `stack-trace` | Stack Trace | You show an error's frames, with library frames folded and frames that open files. |
| `test-results` | Test Results | You show a test run's counts over a tree of suites and failures. |
| `transcript` | Transcript | You show timed, speaker-labelled speech with search and seeking. |
| `selection` | Selection | A person selects text in a reply and picks an action for it. |
| `action` | Action | You show an action run on selected text, quoting the text above its result. |

## Indicators and notices

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Status | You show where a run stands as a mark and a word. |
| `notice` | Notice | You show a calm info, success, warning or error callout, optionally dismissible. |
| `guardrail-notice` | Guardrail Notice | A guardrail blocked or filtered content and you say why. |
| `loader` | Loader | Something loads and you need one labeled loading indicator. |
| `thinking-indicator` | Thinking Indicator | The agent is thinking and nothing has streamed yet. |
| `typing-indicator` | Typing Indicator | The agent is about to reply and you show it typing. |
| `streaming-text` | Streaming Text | You stream plain text, not Markdown, and want chunks to fade in. |
| `connection-status` | Connection Status | The connection dropped and the chat counts down to a retry. |
| `quota-notice` | Quota Notice | A usage limit is near or reached and you show how much is left, when it resets and how to upgrade. |

## Thread and shell

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `thread-list` | Thread List | You list past chats, grouped by date, with rename, pin, share and delete. |
| `thread-search` | Thread Search | A person searches past chats in a dialog, or starts a new one. |
| `sidebar` | Sidebar | The chat list sits in a resizable panel beside the chat that becomes a drawer on phones. |
| `day-separator` | Day Separator | Messages span days and you put a Today or Yesterday heading between them. |
| `share-dialog` | Share Dialog | A person chooses who can open a chat and copies its link. |
| `conversation-search` | Conversation Search | A person finds text in a long conversation, with marks on the scrollbar. |

## Agent ops

| Item | Component | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trace` | Trace | You show an agent run's model calls, tool calls and subagents on one time axis. |
| `run-timeline` | Run Timeline | You show what happened in a run, in time order, from start to the step running now. |
| `schedule-card` | Schedule Card | A recurring agent run needs its schedule, next and last run, an on/off switch and Run now in one place. |
| `agent-card` | Agent Card | The app has several agents and shows who one is, what it can do, and a way to open or start it. |
| `usage-meter` | Usage Meter | You show usage against a limit, like spend, requests or tokens this month, with what makes it up. |
| `activity-graph` | Activity Graph | You show how much an agent ran each day over a year, as a calendar heat map. |
